# Search for one-stop flights from ORD to SFO on 2026-09-09 using connecting pairs
connect_script = """
import sqlite3, json

db = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
cur = db.cursor()

# Get all flights from state-travel skill
cur.execute("SELECT flight_id, airline_code, origin, destination, departure_time, arrival_time, stops, cabin_prices_json, dates_json FROM flights WHERE source_skill='state-travel'")
cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
all_flights = [dict(zip(cols, r)) for r in cur.fetchall()]
print(f"Total state-travel flights: {len(all_flights)}")

# Check which flights have 2026-09-09 available
target_date = "2026-09-09"
available = []
for f in all_flights:
    dates = json.loads(f['dates_json']) if f['dates_json'] else {}
    if target_date in dates:
        info = dates[target_date]
        if info.get('status') == 'available':
            f['date_info'] = info
            available.append(f)

print(f"Flights available on {target_date}: {len(available)}")
for f in available:
    print(f"  {f['flight_id']}: {f['origin']}->{f['destination']} stops={f['stops']} prices={json.dumps(f['date_info'].get('prices',{}))}")

# Look for one-stop flights originating from ORD going to SFO
ord_sfo_direct = [f for f in available if f['origin']=='ORD' and f['destination']=='SFO' and f['stops']==1]
print(f"Direct one-stop ORD->SFO: {len(ord_sfo_direct)}")
for f in ord_sfo_direct:
    print(json.dumps(f, indent=2, default=str))

# Also look for connecting pairs: ORD->X then X->SFO
ord_flights = [f for f in available if f['origin']=='ORD']
sfo_flights = [f for f in available if f['destination']=='SFO']
print(f"Flights from ORD on {target_date}: {len(ord_flights)}")
print(f"Flights to SFO on {target_date}: {len(sfo_flights)}")

connections = []
for f1 in ord_flights:
    for f2 in sfo_flights:
        if f1['destination'] == f2['origin'] and f1['flight_id'] != f2['flight_id']:
            connections.append((f1, f2))

print(f"Connecting pairs ORD->X->SFO: {len(connections)}")
for f1, f2 in connections:
    p1 = f1['date_info'].get('prices',{}).get('economy','?')
    p2 = f2['date_info'].get('prices',{}).get('economy','?')
    print(f"  {f1['flight_id']} {f1['origin']}->{f1['destination']} ${p1} + {f2['flight_id']} {f2['origin']}->{f2['destination']} ${p2}")

db.close()
"""
